verdict.headline: Rejected at T1 gate_a: Hardware output differs from the declared semantics

labels.MEASURED: counted or timed by the evaluator in this evaluation (simulation cycles, synthesised cells, wall time)
labels.PROJECTED: a calibrated model applied to measured evidence (28 nm target view); not silicon
labels.ESTIMATED: an estimator or proxy with a stated envelope (45 nm macro views, NAND2 equivalents, DRAM physics)
labels.RANGE: no point value: lo..hi are the sum of point values and declared bounds (energy estimate tier)
labels.DECLARED: stated by the submission (cf-stack.json); not verified by itself
labels.UNRESOLVED: no trustworthy value exists yet; value is null and `reason` says why

sky130.reason: no sky130 flow in this pipeline version; reported here when one runs

energy.note: energy is reported, never scored or gated in v2.0; terms are listed as the ledger has them

estimate.note: a separate, display-only tier: counted macro accesses and installed cells x Liberty/menu coefficients plus this run's DRAM terms. ESTIMATED or RANGE, never MEASURED; never scored.

t0.statement: cf-stack.json is valid cf-stack/1 and names existing files, menu entries and a published division.
Every file has an allowed SPDX licence.
The npu RTL describes hardware only, elaborates with npu as top and matches the v8 slot.
Two clean builds of the committed compiler source are byte-identical.

gate_a.statement: bit-exact agreement of committed hardware outputs with the submission's own exact semantics on every timed input

gate_b.note: thresholds are hidden-check parameters and are not shown

hidden_variants.note: unseen structural variants compiled and checked bit-exact plus numerical health; per base model pass/fail only (variant shapes, inputs and bounds withheld)

speed_screen.note: one SingleStream query per model against the published G2 latency ceiling before the full campaigns

initialization.note: outputs unchanged under randomized uninitialized state and relocation

audit.note: extra hidden inputs checked by Gate A; inputs withheld

physical.method: RTL vs priced gate netlist on the same stimulus

physical.note: passed = the charged area's partition bias is within the published bound

secret_weights.note: every model compiled from a secret value draw of its published weights; draw withheld

verification.how: receipt_sha256 binds every record digest listed here; a holder of the receipt and records recomputes each sha256 and the receipt digest (orchestrator/receipt.py)

withheld: secret-weight draw seeds, keys, salts, their commitments and the drawn models' digests
hidden timed, audit and private-fixture input identities, item lists and input/output digests
hidden structural variant identities and families (count and pass/fail only)
thresholds and allowances of hidden checks; metric values on private splits (verdict and size only)
exploit-detection internals: a -1 shows its code and a one-line reason, never the detection log
validator host paths, host names, problem metadata and tool logs
copy/lineage comparisons: not an evaluator output
baseline absolute values until ChipForge publishes its baseline constants (ratios only until then)
